emendations.rationale: The word is an evident typographical error in a sentence defining the Fitting ideal of a subobject.
The cited lemma states that localizations at maximal ideals are valuation rings.
The extra preposition makes the sentence ungrammatical.
The product factors were introduced as R_j on the preceding line.
The proof uses f_j at line 37913 without defining it; each projection R to the local factor R_j has a principal kernel.
The local factor under discussion is R_j, consistently with the decomposition and the subsequent M_j notation.
The indefinite article is grammatically incorrect before a vowel sound.
The opening sentence is missing the preposition introducing the class of rings for which existence is asserted.
The proof localizes R/fR at the associated prime q_j; the missing subscript changes the expression.
The full list was introduced as q_1 through q_s; q_j is merely the running index.
The summation subscript is malformed; the divisor is the sum over i from 1 through r.
The system of parameters was declared as g_1 through g_d; n is not defined in this lemma.
The parameter ideal must use all declared parameters g_1 through g_d.
A reduced ring injects into the product over all of its minimal primes, not only the t top-dimensional ones.
The exact injection must take the product over all s minimal primes.
The preceding sentence defines the parameter ideal with f and g_1 through g_{d-1}; plain g is undefined.
This repeated argument likewise requires localization at q_j.
The associated-prime list runs from q_1 through q_s.
The invoked lemma and every subsequent formula require the full sequence g_1 through g_{d-1}.
In a catenary local domain of dimension d, a height-one prime has quotient dimension d-1.
The last member is the prime ideal mathfrak q_s, consistently with the preceding members.
The repeated radical ideal uses the same prime ideal mathfrak q_s.
The article before the displayed inequality is ungrammatical.
The sentence chooses one complex N^bullet, so the noun must be singular.
The relative clause lacks its verb; it refers to the displayed exact sequence.
The finite index set is missing the comma before its last entry.
The phrase is missing the preposition joining linear combination to the images.
The generator s'+m' lies in P/JP and generally not in M'; the next line chooses a splitting P/JP to R/J.
The adjective contains an evident typographical omission.
This definition of M must use the complete list p_1 through p_s of minimal primes fixed in the corrected lines 38314 and 38318; t is reserved below for the top-dimensional sublist.
The localized product is the same full product M over p_1 through p_s; retaining t here contradicts both its definition and the localization argument, while t remains unchanged at lines 38341--38342.
